title: selaginella subfimbriata var. polyura
intro: Selaginella subfimbriata var. polyura, commonly known as Spiny Cliff Brake, is a species of flowering plant in the family Selaginellaceae. It is a type of resurrection fern that is native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella subfimbriata var. polyura include antimicrobial and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
